author: Jeremy Goldstein
title: Alysa Liu names her 'Olympic crush' after returning from Milan-Cortina Village - NewsBreak
text:
By Jeremy Goldstein ,
1 hours ago 20-year-old Alysa Liu captured the American public's attention at the 2026 Milan Winter Olympics, winning a pair of gold medals in figure skating with a slew of breathtaking performances.
When asked by Self magazine who her Olympic "crush" is, Liu called back to another young American Olympic phenom: gymnast Suni Lee. Now 22, Lee was the talk of both the 2024 Games in Paris and the 2020 Games in Tokyo (held in 2021), winning gold medals at both tournaments with Team USA .
“I think my Olympic crush is probably Suni Lee," Liu said. "She’s so pretty and very stylized. You know what I’m saying? I like that, yeah.”
• Fresh curling scandal brewing in Milan as Paralympics investigation launched
• Eileen Gu hits back over choosing China over USA after being slammed by JD Vance
Lee captured the all-around gymnastics gold medals at the 2020 Tokyo Games at just 19 years old. That same year, she also won a silver in the team event with her American side and a bronze in the uneven bars.
In Paris, Lee was part of an American team alongside Simone Biles that won the team gold. She also captured the bronze in both the all-around event and uneven bars.
Liu became the first American figure skater to win an individual gold medal at the Winter Olympics in over 20 years. She was also part of the American victory in the team event.
When asked about her dating life during a January interview with Cosmopolitan, the 20-year-old was coy. "That’s a whole other thing that I’m not feeling right now," she said.
"I have so much love in my life already, and I have so many amazing people, I just haven’t felt the need to look for more or look elsewhere. I really love myself," Liu continued. "And my standards are quite high, too. But also, my schedule, especially since starting to skate again, is pretty hectic.
"If I were to date someone, we’d each have to make tons of sacrifices. It’s just not worth it at this point to build something. I think when it comes, it will. I love being single, I really do. I do see myself being single for a long time. Especially right now, I choose friendships over relationships any day."
• LA Olympics 2028 boss Casey Wasserman's creepy "massage" emails to Ghislaine Maxwell exposed
• Team USA hockey captain left unable to walk 'the best' after major revelation
Liu wasn't the only athlete who answered questions for Self. Speed skater Brittany Bowe went with her fiancée, Hillary Knight, on Team USA hockey. "Oh my gosh, the one and only Hillary Knight," she said.
Fellow figure skater Amber Glenn went for another gymnast. "I have many Olympic crushes, [including] Laurie Hernandez,” Glenn said. “I love that she’s openly queer and that she is completely herself, a little bit of a nerd, just like me."
